parameters.content:
## One entry point
The only Telegram Trigger for this bot. Every tap and message enters here, is normalised and answered (Answer Query) first.

## Only the owner's chat
A button only counts when bundle.telegram_chat_id equals the chat that pressed it. Anything else gets the help text.

## State guard
Resolve + State Guard checks (bundle.status, action) against the state machine. Not allowed → msg_already_handled, nothing changes.

## Edit → parse → confirm card → confirm
Free text → Parse edit (regex, Gemini, validation). Valid changes become a confirm card; only Confirm writes to Yext.

## Fallback
Unknown chats, expired sessions and plain messages get msg_help. Database errors stop before Yext and notify owner + staff.

nodeGroups.name: Read update and bundle
nodeGroups.description: Answers the button tap, loads the bundle and open chat session, and checks the status transition is allowed.

nodeGroups.name: Understand owner reply
nodeGroups.description: Free text in an open edit session goes to the parser; every tap or text becomes one fixed plan of changes.

nodeGroups.name: Save changes
nodeGroups.description: Writes final hours, bundle status, chat session and permission, logs the decision; any write error stops before Yext.

nodeGroups.name: Apply or reply
nodeGroups.description: Approved bundles go to the Yext apply step; everything else gets its reply in the owner language.
